title: MCP Server Compliance Test Rules
description: Machine-readable catalog of compliance test rules for MCP servers. Rules are grouped by the MCP specification revision they apply to (specVersion); ids are only comparable within one revision.

categories.name: Transport Validation
categories.description: Streamable HTTP and stdio transport compliance at the wire level

categories.name: Lifecycle & Protocol
categories.description: Connection setup (initialize handshake or per-request _meta plus server/discover), capabilities, and protocol compliance

categories.name: Tool Operations
categories.description: Tool listing, calling, caching hints, and pagination

categories.name: Resource Operations
categories.description: Resource listing, reading, templates, caching hints, pagination, and subscriptions

categories.name: Prompt Operations
categories.description: Prompt listing, retrieval, caching hints, and pagination

categories.name: Error Handling
categories.description: JSON-RPC error responses and error codes
categories.scope: always runs (some rules capability-gated on tools)

categories.name: Schema Validation
categories.description: Structural validation of tool, resource, and prompt definitions and of every recorded server message
categories.scope: capability-gated for definition checks; post-hoc recording scans always run

categories.name: Security Validation
categories.description: Authentication, input validation, tool integrity, and information disclosure tests
categories.scope: runs after all functional tests (input validation and tool integrity rules capability-gated on tools)

rules.name: HTTP POST accepted
rules.description: Verifies the server accepts HTTP POST requests with JSON-RPC payloads
rules.passCriteria: HTTP 2xx response for POST with JSON-RPC body
rules.failCriteria: Non-2xx response

rules.name: Responds with JSON or SSE
rules.description: Verifies the server responds with a valid Content-Type header
rules.passCriteria: Content-Type includes application/json or text/event-stream
rules.failCriteria: Content-Type is neither application/json nor text/event-stream

rules.name: Rejects non-JSON request Content-Type
rules.description: Sends POST with Content-Type: text/plain and verifies server rejects it
rules.passCriteria: Server returns 4xx for non-application/json Content-Type
rules.failCriteria: Server accepts request with incorrect Content-Type

rules.name: GET returns SSE stream or 405
rules.description: Verifies the server handles GET requests appropriately
rules.passCriteria: Returns 405, text/event-stream, or any 2xx response
rules.failCriteria: Returns a non-2xx, non-405 response

rules.name: DELETE accepted or returns 405
rules.description: Verifies the server handles DELETE requests appropriately
rules.passCriteria: Returns 405, any 2xx, 400, or 404 response
rules.failCriteria: Returns a response other than 405, 2xx, 400, or 404

rules.name: Rejects JSON-RPC batch requests
rules.description: Verifies the server rejects JSON-RPC batch (array) requests
rules.passCriteria: Returns 4xx HTTP status or JSON-RPC error for batch array
rules.failCriteria: Processes batch request or returns no error

rules.name: Notification returns 202 Accepted
rules.description: Verifies the server returns exactly HTTP 202 Accepted for JSON-RPC notifications (MUST per spec)
rules.passCriteria: HTTP 202 Accepted response
rules.failCriteria: Any status code other than 202 (including 200, 204)

rules.name: Enforces MCP-Session-Id after init
rules.description: Verifies the server enforces MCP-Session-Id header after initialization
rules.passCriteria: Returns 400 for missing session ID, or auto-pass if no session ID was issued
rules.failCriteria: Returns 2xx without required session ID header

rules.name: Returns 404 for unknown session ID
rules.description: Sends request with fabricated MCP-Session-Id, verifies server returns 404
rules.passCriteria: HTTP 404 for unknown session ID
rules.failCriteria: Server accepts unknown session ID or returns wrong status code

rules.name: Initialize response has valid content type
rules.description: Validates that the initialize response uses application/json or text/event-stream content type
rules.passCriteria: Content-Type is application/json or text/event-stream
rules.failCriteria: Content-Type is neither application/json nor text/event-stream

rules.name: GET with session returns SSE or 405
rules.description: Tests the GET endpoint with an active session ID for server-initiated messages
rules.passCriteria: Returns text/event-stream or 405 Method Not Allowed
rules.failCriteria: Returns other status or content type

rules.name: Handles concurrent requests
rules.description: Sends multiple JSON-RPC requests in parallel and verifies correct responses
rules.passCriteria: All concurrent requests receive responses with correct matching IDs
rules.failCriteria: Any response has mismatched ID or non-2xx status

rules.name: SSE responses include event: message
rules.description: Checks that SSE responses include the required event: message field
rules.passCriteria: SSE response includes event: message, or server responds with JSON (not SSE)
rules.failCriteria: SSE response has data: fields but no event: message field

rules.name: Initialize handshake
rules.description: Verifies the server completes the initialize handshake
rules.passCriteria: Result contains protocolVersion field
rules.failCriteria: protocolVersion is missing from result

rules.name: Returns valid protocol version
rules.description: Verifies the server returns a valid protocol version string
rules.passCriteria: protocolVersion is in YYYY-MM-DD format
rules.failCriteria: protocolVersion is not in YYYY-MM-DD format

rules.name: Includes serverInfo
rules.description: Verifies the server includes serverInfo in the initialize response
rules.passCriteria: serverInfo object is present with a name field
rules.failCriteria: serverInfo or name is missing

rules.name: Returns capabilities object
rules.description: Verifies the server returns a capabilities object
rules.passCriteria: capabilities is present and is an object
rules.failCriteria: capabilities is missing or not an object

rules.name: Response is valid JSON-RPC 2.0
rules.description: Verifies the server returns valid JSON-RPC 2.0 responses
rules.passCriteria: Response has jsonrpc="2.0", id present, and result or error present
rules.failCriteria: Missing jsonrpc, id, or both result and error fields

rules.name: Responds to ping
rules.description: Verifies the server responds to ping requests
rules.passCriteria: Result is present in the response
rules.failCriteria: Error response or no result

rules.name: Instructions field is valid
rules.description: Verifies the instructions field, if present, is a valid string
rules.passCriteria: instructions is absent or is a string
rules.failCriteria: instructions is present but not a string

rules.name: Response ID matches request ID
rules.description: Verifies the server echoes back the correct request ID
rules.passCriteria: Response id === request id
rules.failCriteria: Response id does not match request id

rules.name: Supports string request IDs
rules.description: Sends request with string id and verifies server echoes it back correctly
rules.passCriteria: String id echoed back with correct value and type
rules.failCriteria: Server does not echo back string id correctly

rules.name: Handles unknown protocol version
rules.description: Sends initialize with future protocol version, verifies server negotiates down or errors
rules.passCriteria: Server returns its own supported version or rejects with error
rules.failCriteria: Server blindly accepts impossible future version

rules.name: Rejects second initialize request
rules.description: Sends second initialize in same session, verifies server rejects it
rules.passCriteria: Server returns error or 4xx for duplicate initialize
rules.failCriteria: Server accepts second initialize without error

rules.name: logging/setLevel accepted
rules.description: Verifies the server accepts logging/setLevel requests
rules.passCriteria: No error in response, or auto-pass if logging capability not advertised
rules.failCriteria: Error response when logging capability is advertised

rules.name: completion/complete accepted
rules.description: Verifies the server handles completion/complete requests
rules.passCriteria: Result returned or -32602 error, or auto-pass if completions capability not advertised
rules.failCriteria: Error other than -32602 when completions capability is advertised

rules.name: Handles cancellation notifications
rules.description: Verifies the server accepts notifications/cancelled without error
rules.passCriteria: Server accepts cancellation notification (2xx response)
rules.failCriteria: Server returns error for cancellation notification

rules.name: Handles progress notifications gracefully
rules.description: Sends notifications/progress to the server and verifies it handles it gracefully. Note: per spec, progress flows server-to-client; this tests resilience to unexpected notifications.
rules.passCriteria: Server accepts notification without error (2xx response)
rules.failCriteria: Server returns non-2xx for an unexpected notification

rules.name: Accepts listChanged notifications
rules.description: Sends listChanged notifications for declared capabilities and verifies server accepts them
rules.passCriteria: Server accepts all applicable listChanged notifications (2xx)
rules.failCriteria: Server rejects listChanged notification with non-2xx

rules.name: Supports progress tokens in requests
rules.description: Sends request with _meta.progressToken and checks for progress events in SSE
rules.passCriteria: Server accepts request with progressToken (progress events optional)
rules.failCriteria: Server rejects request with progressToken

rules.name: tools/list returns valid response
rules.description: Verifies the server returns a valid tools/list response
rules.passCriteria: Returns a tools array
rules.failCriteria: Response does not contain a tools array

rules.name: tools/call responds correctly
rules.description: Verifies the server responds correctly to tools/call requests
rules.passCriteria: Returns content array or any JSON-RPC error
rules.failCriteria: Returns neither content array nor error

rules.name: tools/list supports pagination
rules.description: Verifies the server supports pagination for tools/list
rules.passCriteria: No nextCursor (single page) or valid string cursor with working next page
rules.failCriteria: Invalid cursor value or broken pagination

rules.name: Tool content items have valid types
rules.description: Verifies that tool call content items use valid type values
rules.passCriteria: All content item types are in [text, image, audio, resource, resource_link] or tool returns an error
rules.failCriteria: Content item has an unknown type

rules.name: resources/list returns valid response
rules.description: Verifies the server returns a valid resources/list response
rules.passCriteria: Returns a resources array
rules.failCriteria: Response does not contain a resources array

rules.name: resources/read returns content
rules.description: Verifies the server returns valid content for resources/read
rules.passCriteria: Returns contents array with uri and text or blob fields
rules.failCriteria: Missing contents array, uri, or both text and blob

rules.name: resources/templates/list returns valid response
rules.description: Verifies the server returns a valid resource templates response
rules.passCriteria: Returns resourceTemplates array or -32601 (method not found) error
rules.failCriteria: Error other than -32601

rules.name: resources/list supports pagination
rules.description: Verifies the server supports pagination for resources/list
rules.passCriteria: No nextCursor (single page) or valid string cursor with working next page
rules.failCriteria: Invalid cursor value or broken pagination

rules.name: Resource subscribe/unsubscribe
rules.description: Verifies the server supports resource subscribe and unsubscribe
rules.passCriteria: Both subscribe and unsubscribe succeed
rules.failCriteria: Either subscribe or unsubscribe returns an error

rules.name: prompts/list returns valid response
rules.description: Verifies the server returns a valid prompts/list response
rules.passCriteria: Returns a prompts array
rules.failCriteria: Response does not contain a prompts array

rules.name: prompts/get returns valid messages
rules.description: Verifies the server returns valid messages for prompts/get
rules.passCriteria: Returns messages array with role and content fields, or error
rules.failCriteria: Invalid messages structure

rules.name: prompts/list supports pagination
rules.description: Verifies the server supports pagination for prompts/list
rules.passCriteria: No nextCursor (single page) or valid string cursor with working next page
rules.failCriteria: Invalid cursor value or broken pagination

rules.name: Returns JSON-RPC error for unknown method
rules.description: Verifies the server returns a JSON-RPC error for unknown methods
rules.passCriteria: Any JSON-RPC error response
rules.failCriteria: No error returned for unknown method

rules.name: Uses correct JSON-RPC error code for unknown method
rules.description: Verifies the server uses the standard error code for unknown methods
rules.passCriteria: Error code === -32601 (Method not found)
rules.failCriteria: Error code is not -32601

rules.name: Handles malformed JSON-RPC
rules.description: Verifies the server handles malformed JSON-RPC requests
rules.passCriteria: JSON-RPC error response or HTTP 4xx status
rules.failCriteria: Neither JSON-RPC error nor HTTP 4xx

rules.name: Handles invalid JSON body
rules.description: Verifies the server handles invalid JSON in the request body
rules.passCriteria: JSON-RPC error response or HTTP 4xx status
rules.failCriteria: Neither JSON-RPC error nor HTTP 4xx

rules.name: Returns error for tools/call without name
rules.description: Verifies the server returns an error when tools/call is missing the name parameter
rules.passCriteria: JSON-RPC error or isError flag in result
rules.failCriteria: No error returned

rules.name: Returns -32700 for invalid JSON
rules.description: Verifies the server returns the standard parse error code for invalid JSON
rules.passCriteria: Error code === -32700 (Parse error)
rules.failCriteria: Error code is not -32700 or no error

rules.name: Returns -32600 for invalid request
rules.description: Verifies the server returns the standard error code for invalid requests
rules.passCriteria: Error code === -32600 (Invalid Request)
rules.failCriteria: Error code is not -32600 or no error

rules.name: Returns error for unknown tool name
rules.description: Verifies the server returns an error when calling an unknown tool
rules.passCriteria: JSON-RPC error or isError=true in result
rules.failCriteria: No error returned for unknown tool

rules.name: Rejects methods for undeclared capabilities
rules.description: Calls list methods for undeclared capabilities and verifies server returns errors
rules.passCriteria: Server returns error for methods of undeclared capabilities
rules.failCriteria: Server returns success for methods it did not declare capability for

rules.name: Handles invalid pagination cursor gracefully
rules.description: Sends garbage pagination cursor to a list method
rules.passCriteria: Server returns error or ignores invalid cursor
rules.failCriteria: Server crashes or returns no error/result

rules.name: All tools have name and inputSchema
rules.description: Verifies all tools have a valid name and inputSchema
rules.passCriteria: All tools have valid name (1-128 chars, [A-Za-z0-9_.\-]+) and inputSchema object with type "object"
rules.failCriteria: Any tool has invalid name or missing/invalid inputSchema

rules.name: Tool annotations are valid
rules.description: Verifies tool annotations have correct types
rules.passCriteria: Hint fields are booleans, title field is a string
rules.failCriteria: Type mismatch in annotation fields

rules.name: Tools include title field
rules.description: Verifies the tool title field, if present, is valid
rules.passCriteria: title is absent or is a valid string
rules.failCriteria: title is present but not a string

rules.name: Tools with outputSchema are valid
rules.description: Verifies tools with outputSchema have a valid JSON Schema object
rules.passCriteria: outputSchema is absent or is a valid JSON Schema object
rules.failCriteria: outputSchema is present but not a valid JSON Schema object

rules.name: Prompts have name field
rules.description: Verifies all prompts have a name field and valid arguments
rules.passCriteria: All prompts have a name field and valid arguments if present
rules.failCriteria: Any prompt is missing name or has invalid arguments

rules.name: Resources have uri and name
rules.description: Verifies all resources have a valid parseable URI and name
rules.passCriteria: All resources have a valid parseable URI and name field
rules.failCriteria: Any resource is missing uri, has an invalid URI, or is missing name

rules.name: Rejects unauthenticated requests
rules.description: Verifies the server rejects requests without an Authorization header
rules.passCriteria: HTTP 401 or 403 for unauthenticated request
rules.failCriteria: Server accepts unauthenticated request or no auth is configured

rules.name: 401 responses include WWW-Authenticate header
rules.description: Checks that 401 responses include WWW-Authenticate header per RFC 9110
rules.passCriteria: 401 response includes WWW-Authenticate header, or server returns 403
rules.failCriteria: 401 response missing WWW-Authenticate header

rules.name: Rejects malformed auth credentials
rules.description: Verifies the server rejects malformed Authorization header values
rules.passCriteria: HTTP 401 or 403 for garbage auth token
rules.failCriteria: Server accepts malformed auth token

rules.name: Enforces HTTPS/TLS
rules.description: Verifies the server rejects plaintext HTTP connections when HTTPS is configured
rules.passCriteria: HTTP connection rejected, redirected, or server URL uses HTTP (skipped)
rules.failCriteria: Server accepts plaintext HTTP alongside HTTPS

rules.name: Session IDs are high-entropy
rules.description: Verifies MCP-Session-Id values are cryptographically random
rules.passCriteria: Session ID is ≥16 chars, non-sequential, with high character diversity
rules.failCriteria: Session ID is short, purely numeric, or low-entropy

rules.name: Session ID does not bypass auth
rules.description: Verifies that a valid session ID alone is not sufficient for authentication
rules.passCriteria: HTTP 401 or 403 when session ID is sent without Authorization header
rules.failCriteria: Server accepts request with session ID but no auth

rules.name: Protected Resource Metadata endpoint exists
rules.description: Verifies the Protected Resource Metadata (RFC 9728) endpoint exists at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. Falls back to legacy /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server with a warning.
rules.passCriteria: /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource returns valid JSON with resource and authorization_servers, or legacy OAuth AS metadata exists
rules.failCriteria: Neither PRM nor legacy OAuth AS metadata endpoint is reachable or valid

rules.name: Rejects auth tokens in query string
rules.description: Verifies the server does not accept auth tokens in the URL query string
rules.passCriteria: HTTP 401 or 403 when token is in query string instead of Authorization header
rules.failCriteria: Server accepts token from query string

rules.name: CORS headers are restrictive
rules.description: Verifies CORS headers do not use wildcard origin
rules.passCriteria: No CORS headers, or Access-Control-Allow-Origin is not '*' or reflected
rules.failCriteria: Access-Control-Allow-Origin is '*' or reflects arbitrary origins

rules.name: Validates Origin header on requests
rules.description: Sends request with suspicious Origin header, verifies server validates it for DNS rebinding protection
rules.passCriteria: Server rejects request with untrusted Origin (4xx response)
rules.failCriteria: Server accepts request with untrusted Origin header

rules.name: Resists command injection in tool params
rules.description: Verifies tools do not execute OS command injection payloads in string parameters
rules.passCriteria: Injection payloads do not produce command execution output
rules.failCriteria: Tool output contains evidence of command execution

rules.name: Resists SQL injection in tool params
rules.description: Verifies tools do not expose SQL injection vulnerabilities
rules.passCriteria: Injection payloads do not trigger database errors or data leakage
rules.failCriteria: Tool output contains SQL error messages or database metadata

rules.name: Resists path traversal in tool params
rules.description: Verifies tools do not allow path traversal attacks via string parameters
rules.passCriteria: Traversal payloads do not return sensitive file content
rules.failCriteria: Tool output contains content from /etc/passwd or system files

rules.name: Resists SSRF to internal networks
rules.description: Verifies tools with URL parameters do not fetch internal/cloud metadata endpoints
rules.passCriteria: Internal IP payloads do not return cloud metadata or internal service data
rules.failCriteria: Tool output contains cloud metadata or internal network responses

rules.name: Handles oversized inputs gracefully
rules.description: Verifies the server handles 1MB+ payloads without crashing
rules.passCriteria: HTTP 413, any 4xx error, or server handles gracefully without timeout
rules.failCriteria: Server times out or crashes under oversized input

rules.name: Rejects or ignores extra tool params
rules.description: Verifies the server handles unexpected additional tool parameters safely
rules.passCriteria: Server rejects extra params with error or silently ignores them
rules.failCriteria: Server crashes or processes __proto__ pollution attempts

rules.name: All tools define inputSchema
rules.description: Verifies all tools have an inputSchema with type 'object' for input validation
rules.passCriteria: All tools have inputSchema with type: 'object'
rules.failCriteria: Any tool is missing inputSchema or has wrong type

rules.name: Tool definitions are stable across calls
rules.description: Verifies tool definitions do not change between consecutive tools/list calls
rules.passCriteria: Tool count, names, and descriptions are identical across 2 calls
rules.failCriteria: Tool definitions changed between calls (possible rug-pull attack)

rules.name: Tool descriptions free of injection patterns
rules.description: Scans tool descriptions for prompt injection patterns and hidden characters
rules.passCriteria: No suspicious patterns found in tool names, descriptions, or parameter descriptions
rules.failCriteria: Tool descriptions contain 'ignore previous', 'override', hidden Unicode, or Base64 payloads

rules.name: Tools do not reference other tools by name
rules.description: Checks that tool descriptions do not reference other tool names
rules.passCriteria: No tool description contains the name of another tool
rules.failCriteria: Tool description references another tool by name (manipulation risk)

rules.name: Error responses do not leak stack traces
rules.description: Verifies error responses do not contain stack traces, file paths, or sensitive data
rules.passCriteria: No stack traces, file paths, connection strings, or credentials in error responses
rules.failCriteria: Error response contains implementation details or sensitive information

rules.name: Error responses do not leak internal IPs
rules.description: Verifies error responses do not contain private IP addresses
rules.passCriteria: No 10.x, 172.16-31.x, 192.168.x, or 127.x addresses in error responses
rules.failCriteria: Error response contains internal IP addresses

rules.name: Rate limiting is enforced
rules.description: Verifies the server implements rate limiting under burst load
rules.passCriteria: HTTP 429 returned during 50-request burst
rules.failCriteria: All 50 rapid requests accepted without rate limiting

rules.name: Newline-delimited JSON framing
rules.description: Verifies a stdio server emits each JSON-RPC response as a single line on stdout, terminated by \n, under rapid-fire requests
rules.passCriteria: Every response is exactly one newline-terminated line of parseable JSON
rules.failCriteria: Any response is split across lines, merged with another response, or missing a trailing newline

rules.name: UTF-8 unicode roundtrip
rules.description: Sends non-ASCII (CJK + emoji) parameters to a stdio server and verifies the response preserves the byte-level encoding
rules.passCriteria: Response echoes the non-ASCII payload byte-for-byte when decoded as UTF-8
rules.failCriteria: Response returns mojibake, replacement characters, or byte-mangled output

rules.name: Recovers after unknown method
rules.description: Sends an unknown method followed by a valid ping; verifies the server errors on the unknown method but keeps serving subsequent requests
rules.passCriteria: Unknown method receives a JSON-RPC error and the follow-up ping succeeds
rules.failCriteria: Server exits, closes stdout, or fails to respond to the follow-up ping

rules.name: Sampling capability shape
rules.description: Verifies the server's initialize response does NOT declare sampling as its own capability (sampling is a client capability)
rules.passCriteria: Server capabilities object does not contain a 'sampling' key
rules.failCriteria: Server declares 'sampling' in its own capabilities

rules.name: Roots capability shape
rules.description: Verifies the server's initialize response does NOT declare roots as its own capability (roots is a client capability)
rules.passCriteria: Server capabilities object does not contain a 'roots' key
rules.failCriteria: Server declares 'roots' in its own capabilities

rules.name: Elicitation capability shape
rules.description: Verifies the server's initialize response does NOT declare elicitation as its own capability (elicitation is a client capability added in 2025-11-25)
rules.passCriteria: Server capabilities object does not contain an 'elicitation' key
rules.failCriteria: Server declares 'elicitation' in its own capabilities

rules.name: Tolerates _meta field on requests
rules.description: Sends a ping with params._meta = { extra: 'value' } and verifies the server does not reject the request. The 2025-11-25 spec reserves _meta for forward-compat extension metadata on any request
rules.passCriteria: Server returns a normal result regardless of unknown _meta keys
rules.failCriteria: Server returns a JSON-RPC error that cites the _meta field

rules.name: HTTP POST accepted
rules.description: POSTs a conformant server/discover request (standard headers plus _meta) to the MCP endpoint and verifies a 2xx status. The server MUST provide a single endpoint that supports POST and every client message MUST be its own POST; this is the baseline every other HTTP test builds on.
rules.passCriteria: HTTP 2xx for a POST carrying a conformant server/discover request (standard headers plus _meta).
rules.failCriteria: Any non-2xx status; 401/403 is annotated as authentication required.

rules.name: Responds with JSON or SSE
rules.description: Checks the Content-Type of the server/discover response. For a JSON-RPC request the server MUST return either application/json (a single object) or text/event-stream (a request-scoped SSE stream); nothing else is valid.
rules.passCriteria: The Content-Type of the server/discover response contains application/json or text/event-stream.
rules.failCriteria: Any other Content-Type, or none.

rules.name: Rejects non-JSON request Content-Type
rules.description: Sends an otherwise valid server/discover (correct headers and _meta) with Content-Type: text/plain and expects a 4xx status. The POST body MUST be a single JSON-RPC message; a server that parses text/plain as JSON is trusting a content type it never checked.
rules.passCriteria: HTTP 4xx (415 or 400 expected) for an otherwise valid server/discover sent with Content-Type: text/plain.
rules.failCriteria: The text/plain body is parsed and answered with a 2xx status.

rules.name: Rejects JSON-RPC batch requests
rules.description: POSTs a JSON array containing two valid server/discover requests and expects a 4xx status or a JSON-RPC error. The POST body MUST be a single JSON-RPC request or notification; batches were dropped in 2025-06-18 and remain unsupported.
rules.passCriteria: A JSON array of two valid server/discover requests draws HTTP 4xx or a JSON-RPC error body.
rules.failCriteria: A 2xx status without a JSON-RPC error, or an array response.

rules.name: Notification returns 202 Accepted
rules.description: POSTs a notifications/cancelled notification (no id) for an unknown request and expects HTTP 202 Accepted with an empty body. If the server accepts a notification it MUST return exactly 202; if it cannot accept it, it MUST return an HTTP error status. 202 passes, a 4xx refusal passes with a warning (this revision defines no client notifications over HTTP), and 200, 204 or 5xx fail.
rules.passCriteria: HTTP 202 for a POSTed notifications/cancelled; a 4xx refusal also passes but is reported as a warning.
rules.failCriteria: HTTP 200, 204, or any 5xx.

rules.name: Handles concurrent requests
rules.description: Fires three server/discover requests in parallel over separate POSTs and verifies every response arrives with its own matching id. Each message is its own HTTP POST with no shared session, so a stateless server must serve overlapping requests without cross-talk.
rules.passCriteria: Three parallel server/discover POSTs each return a 2xx response whose id matches the request that produced it.
rules.failCriteria: Any response missing, non-2xx, or carrying the id of a different request.

rules.name: GET returns 405
rules.description: Sends HTTP GET to the MCP endpoint. The standalone GET SSE stream was removed in 2026-07-28 (subscriptions/listen replaces it) and a server on this revision SHOULD answer legacy GET traffic with 405 Method Not Allowed. 405 passes, another 4xx passes with a warning, and a text/event-stream response fails.
rules.passCriteria: HTTP 405 for GET on the MCP endpoint; another 4xx passes with a warning.
rules.failCriteria: A text/event-stream response, any 2xx, or any 5xx.

rules.name: DELETE returns 405
rules.description: Sends HTTP DELETE to the MCP endpoint. Sessions and their DELETE termination were removed in 2026-07-28, so a server on this revision SHOULD answer with 405 Method Not Allowed. 405 passes, another 4xx passes with a warning, and 2xx or 5xx fail.
rules.passCriteria: HTTP 405 for DELETE on the MCP endpoint; another 4xx passes with a warning.
rules.failCriteria: Any 2xx or 5xx status.

rules.name: Ignores Mcp-Session-Id
rules.description: Sends a valid server/discover carrying a fabricated Mcp-Session-Id header and expects a normal result with no Mcp-Session-Id on the response. Protocol-level sessions are gone: a server SHOULD ignore the header and never mint or echo session ids. A 404 or 400 keyed to the bogus session, or a minted id, fails.
rules.passCriteria: A valid server/discover carrying a fabricated Mcp-Session-Id header returns a normal result with no Mcp-Session-Id header on the response.
rules.failCriteria: HTTP 404 or 400 keyed to the unknown session, or a minted or echoed Mcp-Session-Id response header.

rules.name: Rejects missing MCP-Protocol-Version header
rules.description: Sends a server/discover whose body is complete but whose MCP-Protocol-Version header is omitted. Every POST MUST carry the header, and a server that does not serve pre-2025-06-18 clients MUST reject its absence with HTTP 400 and a -32020 HeaderMismatch error. 400 is the hard requirement; a missing or different error code is reported as a warning.
rules.passCriteria: HTTP 400 for a complete server/discover body sent without the MCP-Protocol-Version header; a body without error code -32020 is reported as a warning.
rules.failCriteria: Any status other than 400.

rules.name: Rejects header/_meta version mismatch
rules.description: Sends MCP-Protocol-Version: 2026-07-28 with _meta protocolVersion 1999-01-01. The header value MUST match the _meta field, and on a mismatch the server MUST respond 400 Bad Request with a -32020 HeaderMismatch error; both the status and the code are checked here.
rules.passCriteria: HTTP 400 and a JSON-RPC error with code -32020 when the header says 2026-07-28 and _meta says 1999-01-01.
rules.failCriteria: A status other than 400, an error code other than -32020, or a result.

rules.name: Rejects missing Mcp-Method header
rules.description: Sends a valid server/discover body without the Mcp-Method header. Mcp-Method is REQUIRED on every request; a missing standard header is a validation failure and the server MUST answer HTTP 400 with a -32020 HeaderMismatch error. 400 is the hard requirement; the -32020 code is checked as a warning because an intermediary may reject with a bare 400.
rules.passCriteria: HTTP 400 for a valid server/discover body sent without the Mcp-Method header; a missing or different error code is reported as a warning.
rules.failCriteria: Any status other than 400.

rules.name: Rejects Mcp-Method/body mismatch
rules.description: Sends a server/discover body with Mcp-Method: tools/list. A header that does not match the corresponding body value MUST be rejected with HTTP 400 and a -32020 HeaderMismatch error, because a gateway routing on the header and a server executing on the body would otherwise disagree. 400 is required; -32020 is a warning.
rules.passCriteria: HTTP 400 when Mcp-Method: tools/list is sent on a server/discover body; a missing -32020 code is reported as a warning.
rules.failCriteria: Any status other than 400 (the request was routed on one value and executed on another).

rules.name: Rejects Mcp-Name/body mismatch
rules.description: Sends a resources/read (or prompts/get) whose Mcp-Name header names a different resource or prompt than the body. Mcp-Name is REQUIRED on tools/call, resources/read and prompts/get and MUST match params.uri or params.name after Base64 sentinel decoding, so the server MUST answer 400 + -32020. Skipped when the server exposes no resource or prompt to read.
rules.passCriteria: HTTP 400 for a resources/read or prompts/get whose Mcp-Name header names a different object than the body; a missing -32020 code is reported as a warning. Skipped when the server exposes no resource or prompt to read.
rules.failCriteria: Any status other than 400.

rules.name: Header names are case-insensitive
rules.description: Sends a valid server/discover with the standard headers spelled in lowercase (mcp-protocol-version, mcp-method) and expects a normal result. Header names are case-insensitive per RFC 9110 and servers MUST compare them that way; only values are case-sensitive. A 400 HeaderMismatch here means the server matches on exact spelling.
rules.passCriteria: A valid server/discover whose standard headers are spelled in lowercase (mcp-protocol-version, mcp-method) returns a normal result.
rules.failCriteria: HTTP 400 or any other rejection attributable to header spelling.

rules.name: No server-initiated requests on any stream
rules.description: Post-hoc scan of every message the server sent during the run (JSON bodies, SSE frames, stdio lines) for a frame carrying both method and id, i.e. a server-to-client JSON-RPC request. No such direction exists in 2026-07-28: sampling, elicitation and roots MUST travel inside an InputRequiredResult (MRTR), and the server MUST NOT send independent requests on a response stream or to stdout.
rules.passCriteria: No recorded server message on any response stream or on stdout carries both method and id.
rules.failCriteria: At least one server-to-client JSON-RPC request was observed during the run.

rules.name: Newline-delimited JSON framing
rules.description: Writes five server/discover requests to stdin in rapid succession and expects five responses, each a single line of JSON terminated by a newline. Messages are newline-delimited and MUST NOT contain embedded newlines, and the server MUST NOT write anything to stdout that is not a valid MCP message.
rules.passCriteria: Five rapid server/discover requests each receive a response on its own newline-terminated line of JSON.
rules.failCriteria: Any of the five is unanswered, split across lines, or interleaved with non-JSON output on stdout.

rules.name: UTF-8 unicode roundtrip
rules.description: Sends a request whose parameters contain CJK and emoji characters and verifies the response reproduces them byte-for-byte. JSON-RPC messages MUST be UTF-8 encoded on every transport; this catches latin-1 or platform-default decoding of stdin.
rules.passCriteria: CJK and emoji characters sent in request parameters come back byte-for-byte in the response.
rules.failCriteria: Any character is replaced, dropped, or mis-decoded.

rules.name: Recovers after unknown method
rules.description: Sends a bogus method with a full modern _meta, then a valid server/discover immediately after. The unknown method should draw a JSON-RPC error (-32601 expected) and the server must keep serving: the discover that follows must succeed on the same process.
rules.passCriteria: The bogus method draws a JSON-RPC error (-32601 expected) and the server/discover sent immediately after succeeds on the same process.
rules.failCriteria: The process exits, stops answering, or the follow-up server/discover fails.

rules.name: Ignores cancellation of unknown request
rules.description: Writes a notifications/cancelled referencing a request id that was never issued, then a server/discover. On stdio notifications/cancelled is the only cancellation signal and servers MAY ignore one for an unknown or completed request; the discover that follows must still be answered and nothing may be emitted in reply to the notification.
rules.passCriteria: A notifications/cancelled for an unknown requestId produces no reply and the server/discover sent after it is answered normally.
rules.failCriteria: Any message emitted in reply to the notification, or the follow-up server/discover is unanswered.

rules.name: server/discover returns DiscoverResult
rules.description: Sends server/discover with a conformant _meta and expects a result carrying a supportedVersions array and a capabilities object. Servers MUST implement server/discover; it replaces the initialize handshake and is the first response the suite trusts.
rules.passCriteria: server/discover with a conformant _meta returns a result carrying a supportedVersions array and a capabilities object.
rules.failCriteria: A JSON-RPC error, no response, or a result missing either field.

rules.name: supportedVersions are well-formed
rules.description: Validates supportedVersions on the discover result: non-empty, every entry a YYYY-MM-DD string. Warns when 2026-07-28 itself is absent, since the run grades that revision and the server just answered a request declaring it.
rules.passCriteria: supportedVersions is non-empty and every entry is a YYYY-MM-DD string; the absence of 2026-07-28 is reported as a warning.
rules.failCriteria: An empty array, or any entry that is not a date-shaped string.

rules.name: server/discover carries caching hints
rules.description: Checks that the discover result carries ttlMs (an integer >= 0) and cacheScope ('public' or 'private'). Servers MUST include both caching hints on every complete server/discover result; a negative or missing ttlMs or an unknown scope fails.
rules.passCriteria: The server/discover result carries ttlMs as an integer >= 0 and cacheScope equal to public or private.
rules.failCriteria: Either field missing, ttlMs negative or non-integer, or an unknown cacheScope value.

rules.name: Response is valid JSON-RPC 2.0
rules.description: Validates the discover response envelope: jsonrpc is exactly '2.0', the id is echoed, and exactly one of result (an object) or error is present. All MCP messages MUST follow JSON-RPC 2.0 and a result response MUST include a result field.
rules.passCriteria: The server/discover response has jsonrpc exactly '2.0', the request id echoed, and exactly one of result (an object) or error.
rules.failCriteria: A missing or wrong jsonrpc field, a missing id, both or neither of result/error, or a non-object result.

rules.name: Response id matches request id
rules.description: Verifies the id on the discover response equals the id the suite sent. Result and error responses MUST include the same id as the request they answer; the suite issues numeric ids from 1000 upward so a stale or fabricated id is easy to spot.
rules.passCriteria: The id on the server/discover response equals the id the suite sent.
rules.failCriteria: A different, missing, or null id.

rules.name: Supports string request ids
rules.description: Sends server/discover with a string id and expects the response to echo it byte-for-byte as a string, on HTTP and stdio alike. Requests MUST carry a string or integer id and the server MUST return the same one; coercing '42' to 42 or dropping the id fails.
rules.passCriteria: A server/discover sent with a string id is answered with the identical string id.
rules.failCriteria: The id is coerced to a number, replaced, or dropped.

rules.name: Returns capabilities object
rules.description: Checks that the discover result has a capabilities object and that each declared feature (tools, resources, prompts, completions, logging, experimental, extensions) is itself an object. An empty {} is valid; a capability declared as true or a string is not, because sub-features such as listChanged live inside it.
rules.passCriteria: The server/discover result has a capabilities object and every declared feature is itself an object (an empty {} is valid).
rules.failCriteria: capabilities missing or not an object, or a feature declared as a boolean, string, or other non-object.

rules.name: Includes serverInfo in _meta
rules.description: Looks for result._meta['io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo'] on the discover result and checks it carries string name and version fields. Servers SHOULD include serverInfo on every result so a client can identify them without connection state; the report's serverInfo comes from here.
rules.passCriteria: result._meta['io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo'] on the server/discover result carries string name and version fields.
rules.failCriteria: serverInfo absent from _meta, or name or version missing or not strings.

rules.name: Instructions field is valid
rules.description: If the discover result includes instructions, verifies it is a string. Instructions are optional natural-language guidance for the model on how to use the server; absence passes and any other type fails.
rules.passCriteria: instructions is absent from the server/discover result, or present as a string.
rules.failCriteria: instructions is present with a non-string type.

rules.name: Rejects request without _meta
rules.description: Sends server/discover with params carrying no _meta at all (on HTTP the headers are still correct). protocolVersion and clientCapabilities are required on every request, so the request is malformed and the server MUST reject it with -32602 Invalid params; on HTTP the status MUST be 400. A rejection with a different code is reported as a warning; a result fails, because the server is inferring version and capabilities from nowhere.
rules.passCriteria: A server/discover with no params._meta draws a JSON-RPC error (HTTP 400 on HTTP); code -32602 is expected and any other code is reported as a warning.
rules.failCriteria: A result is returned, or on HTTP the error arrives with a status other than 400.

rules.name: Rejects _meta without protocolVersion
rules.description: Sends server/discover whose _meta carries clientCapabilities and clientInfo but no protocolVersion (on HTTP the MCP-Protocol-Version header is present and correct). The field is required, so the server MUST answer -32602 Invalid params and, on HTTP, status 400. A rejection with another code (-32020 is the common one) passes with a warning; a result fails.
rules.passCriteria: A _meta without protocolVersion draws a JSON-RPC error (HTTP 400 on HTTP); -32602 is expected and another code (typically -32020) is reported as a warning.
rules.failCriteria: A result is returned, or on HTTP the error arrives with a status other than 400.

rules.name: Rejects _meta without clientCapabilities
rules.description: Sends server/discover whose _meta has protocolVersion and clientInfo but no clientCapabilities. Capabilities are per-request input the server MUST NOT infer from prior requests, so the field is required even when empty; the server MUST answer -32602 (HTTP 400). Serving the request as if {} had been sent fails.
rules.passCriteria: A _meta without clientCapabilities draws a JSON-RPC error (HTTP 400 on HTTP); -32602 is expected and another code is reported as a warning.
rules.failCriteria: The request is served as if {} had been sent, or on HTTP the error arrives with a status other than 400.

rules.name: Serves _meta without clientInfo
rules.description: Sends server/discover whose _meta has the two required fields but omits clientInfo, and expects a normal result. clientInfo is a SHOULD for clients, not a requirement; a server that rejects its absence blocks conformant clients that are configured not to identify themselves.
rules.passCriteria: A server/discover whose _meta omits clientInfo returns a normal result.
rules.failCriteria: A JSON-RPC error or non-2xx status caused by the missing clientInfo.

rules.name: Rejects unsupported protocol version
rules.description: Sends server/discover declaring protocol version 1999-01-01 in _meta (and in the header on HTTP). A version the server does not implement MUST be answered with UnsupportedProtocolVersionError (-32022) whose data.supported lists the server's versions and data.requested echoes '1999-01-01'; on HTTP the status MUST be 400. data.supported must be non-empty and a subset of the discover result's supportedVersions.
rules.passCriteria: Protocol version 1999-01-01 draws code -32022 with data.supported non-empty and a subset of the discover supportedVersions, data.requested equal to '1999-01-01', and HTTP 400 on HTTP.
rules.failCriteria: A result, a different error code, an empty or malformed data.supported, a wrong data.requested, or on HTTP a status other than 400.

rules.name: Removed legacy methods are rejected
rules.description: Sends ping, logging/setLevel and resources/subscribe with a full modern _meta. All three were removed in 2026-07-28 (there is no keepalive RPC, log level is per-request _meta, subscriptions/listen replaces resources/subscribe), so each should draw a JSON-RPC error. -32601 Method not found (with HTTP 404 on HTTP) is expected; another error code passes with a warning and a result fails.
rules.passCriteria: ping, logging/setLevel and resources/subscribe each draw a JSON-RPC error; -32601 (HTTP 404 on HTTP) is expected and another code or status is reported as a warning.
rules.failCriteria: Any of the three methods returns a result.

rules.name: Legacy initialize probe (informational)
rules.description: Sends a legacy initialize request (2025-11-25 shape, no modern _meta, legacy headers on HTTP) and reports which era the server speaks: a result means dual-era, an error means modern-only. Both outcomes pass; the test is informational. A modern-only server SHOULD name its supported versions in the error it returns to initialize, and one that does not draws a warning. Runs last on stdio because answering initialize may pin a dual-era process to legacy semantics.
rules.passCriteria: Always, on either classification: a result to legacy initialize is reported as dual-era, an error as modern-only; an error that does not name the supported versions is reported as a warning.
rules.failCriteria: Only when the probe could not be classified at all (no response within the timeout).

rules.name: Capability declarations match handlers
rules.description: For each of tools, resources and prompts: when the capability is declared, the corresponding list method must return a result (servers that declare a capability MUST respond to its list request); when it is not declared, the list method must return a JSON-RPC error, -32601 expected. A declared capability whose list fails, or an undeclared one whose list succeeds, fails.
rules.passCriteria: For each of tools, resources and prompts: a declared capability's list method returns a result and an undeclared capability's list method returns a JSON-RPC error (-32601 expected).
rules.failCriteria: A declared capability whose list method errors, or an undeclared capability whose list method returns a result.

rules.name: subscriptions/listen acknowledges first
rules.description: When any listChanged or subscribe capability is declared, opens a subscriptions/listen stream requesting the matching notification types and reads the first frame. It MUST be notifications/subscriptions/acknowledged carrying _meta['io.modelcontextprotocol/subscriptionId'] equal to the listen request's id and a notifications object naming the subset the server honours; no other notification may precede it. When nothing is advertised, either the acknowledgment or -32601 passes.
rules.passCriteria: With a listChanged or subscribe capability declared, the first frame on a subscriptions/listen stream is notifications/subscriptions/acknowledged carrying _meta subscriptionId equal to the request id and a notifications object; with nothing advertised, either that acknowledgment or -32601 passes.
rules.failCriteria: Any other frame first, a subscriptionId that differs from the request id, a missing notifications object, or an error other than -32601 when nothing is advertised.

rules.name: No log notifications without logLevel
rules.description: Post-hoc scan of the recording: every notifications/message the server sent is traced to the request it arrived with, and that request must have carried _meta['io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel']. The server MUST NOT emit notifications/message for a request that did not set a log level; a log frame on a request that never opted in, or on a subscriptions/listen stream, fails.
rules.passCriteria: Every recorded notifications/message arrived on the response to a request that carried _meta['io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel'].
rules.failCriteria: A notifications/message on a request that set no logLevel, or on a subscriptions/listen stream.

rules.name: Tolerates unknown _meta keys
rules.description: Sends server/discover with an extra vendor-prefixed key (com.example.compliance/probe) alongside the required _meta fields and expects a normal result. _meta is an open namespace for third-party and extension metadata, so a server must not reject a request for keys it does not recognise.
rules.passCriteria: A server/discover carrying an extra vendor-prefixed _meta key returns a normal result.
rules.failCriteria: A JSON-RPC error or rejection attributable to the unknown key.

rules.name: completion/complete accepted
rules.description: If the server declares the completions capability, sends completion/complete for the first prompt or resource-template argument and expects a result with a completion.values array (empty is fine). Servers that declare the capability must serve the method; skipped when the capability is absent.
rules.passCriteria: When the completions capability is declared, completion/complete for the first prompt or resource-template argument returns a result with a completion.values array (empty allowed); skipped otherwise.
rules.failCriteria: A JSON-RPC error, or a result without completion.values as an array.

rules.name: Progress notifications echo the token
rules.description: Calls the first tool with _meta.progressToken set and reads the whole response. Progress is optional, so a call with no notifications/progress passes; but any progress notification that does arrive MUST carry the same token and its progress value MUST increase with each notification. A foreign token or a non-increasing value fails.
rules.passCriteria: tools/call with _meta.progressToken completes, and every notifications/progress observed for it carries the same token with a strictly increasing progress value (no notifications at all also passes).
rules.failCriteria: A progress notification carrying a foreign token, or a progress value that does not increase.

rules.name: tools/list returns valid response
rules.description: Calls tools/list and validates the result has a tools array of tool objects. Servers that declare the tools capability MUST respond to tools/list with the set of tools available to the caller; required at runtime when the capability is declared.
rules.passCriteria: tools/list returns a result with a tools array whose entries are objects (empty allowed).
rules.failCriteria: A JSON-RPC error, or a result without a tools array of objects.

rules.name: tools/list carries caching hints
rules.description: Checks that the tools/list result carries ttlMs (an integer >= 0) and cacheScope ('public' or 'private'). Servers MUST include both hints on complete tools/list results; they let clients skip re-fetching and improve prompt-cache hit rates. Required at runtime when the tools capability is declared.
rules.passCriteria: The tools/list result carries ttlMs as an integer >= 0 and cacheScope equal to public or private.
rules.failCriteria: Either hint missing or invalid.

rules.name: tools/list order is deterministic
rules.description: Calls tools/list three times and compares the order of tool names. Servers SHOULD return tools in a deterministic order when the underlying set has not changed; a shuffled order defeats client caching and LLM prompt caching.
rules.passCriteria: Three consecutive tools/list calls return the tool names in the same order.
rules.failCriteria: The order differs between any two of the three calls.

rules.name: tools/call responds correctly
rules.description: Calls the first tool with empty arguments and validates the result shape: resultType 'complete' with a content array, or resultType 'input_required' (an MRTR InputRequiredResult) with inputRequests and/or requestState. A -32602 Invalid params error for a tool that needs arguments also passes. Required at runtime when the tools capability is declared.
rules.passCriteria: Calling the first tool with empty arguments returns resultType 'complete' with a content array, resultType 'input_required' with inputRequests and/or requestState, or a -32602 error for missing arguments.
rules.failCriteria: A result without resultType, a complete result without a content array, an input_required result with neither field, or an error other than -32602.

rules.name: Tool content items have valid types
rules.description: Validates that every item in a tools/call content array has a type of text, image, audio, resource or resource_link. These are the only content types defined for tool results; a typo or missing type breaks client rendering. Required at runtime when the tools capability is declared.
rules.passCriteria: Every item in the tools/call content array has a type of text, image, audio, resource, or resource_link.
rules.failCriteria: Any content item with a missing or unrecognised type.

rules.name: tools/list supports pagination
rules.description: Reads tools/list and, when nextCursor is present, verifies it is a string and that passing it back as cursor returns another valid page. Cursors are opaque and clients MUST NOT assume a page size, so the server decides when to paginate; a list with no nextCursor passes.
rules.passCriteria: No nextCursor on tools/list, or a string nextCursor that yields another valid page when passed back as cursor.
rules.failCriteria: A non-string nextCursor, or a follow-up page that errors or is malformed.

rules.name: resources/list returns valid response
rules.description: Calls resources/list and validates the result has a resources array of objects. Servers that declare the resources capability MUST respond to resources/list; required at runtime when the capability is declared.
rules.passCriteria: resources/list returns a result with a resources array whose entries are objects (empty allowed).
rules.failCriteria: A JSON-RPC error, or a result without a resources array of objects.

rules.name: resources/list carries caching hints
rules.description: Checks ttlMs (an integer >= 0) and cacheScope ('public' or 'private') on the resources/list result. Both caching hints are a MUST on every complete resources/list result. Required at runtime when the resources capability is declared.
rules.passCriteria: The resources/list result carries ttlMs as an integer >= 0 and cacheScope equal to public or private.
rules.failCriteria: Either hint missing or invalid.

rules.name: resources/read returns content
rules.description: Reads the first listed resource and validates the result: resultType 'complete' with a contents array whose items carry uri and either text or blob, or resultType 'input_required' with a valid InputRequiredResult. An empty contents array for a resource the server itself listed passes with a warning. Required at runtime when the resources capability is declared.
rules.passCriteria: Reading the first listed resource returns resultType 'complete' with contents items carrying uri and text or blob, or resultType 'input_required' with a valid InputRequiredResult; an empty contents array passes with a warning.
rules.failCriteria: A JSON-RPC error, a result without resultType, or contents items missing uri or both text and blob.

rules.name: resources/read carries caching hints
rules.description: Checks ttlMs (an integer >= 0) and cacheScope on the resources/read result. resources/read is a cacheable operation and MUST carry both hints on complete results; input_required interim results carry none and are exempt. Required at runtime when the resources capability is declared.
rules.passCriteria: The complete resources/read result carries ttlMs as an integer >= 0 and cacheScope equal to public or private; input_required interim results are exempt.
rules.failCriteria: Either hint missing or invalid on a complete result.

rules.name: Nonexistent resource returns -32602
rules.description: Reads a URI that does not exist and expects a JSON-RPC error. Servers MUST return -32602 Invalid params for a missing resource and MUST NOT return an empty contents array; the retired -32002 code fails because implementations of this revision MUST NOT emit it. data.uri naming the missing resource is a SHOULD, reported as a warning when absent. Required at runtime when the resources capability is declared.
rules.passCriteria: Reading a nonexistent URI draws a JSON-RPC error with code -32602; a missing data.uri is reported as a warning.
rules.failCriteria: A result (including an empty contents array), the retired code -32002, or any code other than -32602.

rules.name: resources/templates/list returns valid response
rules.description: Calls resources/templates/list and validates the result has a resourceTemplates array whose entries carry uriTemplate and name. Templates are optional, so -32601 Method not found passes; a malformed result does not.
rules.passCriteria: resources/templates/list returns a resourceTemplates array whose entries carry uriTemplate and name, or a -32601 Method not found error.
rules.failCriteria: A malformed result, or an error other than -32601.

rules.name: resources/templates/list carries caching hints
rules.description: When resources/templates/list succeeds, checks that the result carries ttlMs (an integer >= 0) and cacheScope. The method is on the list of operations that MUST carry caching hints; skipped when the server does not implement templates.
rules.passCriteria: When resources/templates/list succeeds, its result carries ttlMs as an integer >= 0 and cacheScope equal to public or private; skipped when the method is not implemented.
rules.failCriteria: Either hint missing or invalid on a successful result.

rules.name: resources/list supports pagination
rules.description: Reads resources/list and, when nextCursor is present, verifies it is a string and that passing it back as cursor returns another valid page. Clients MUST treat cursors as opaque tokens and MUST NOT assume a page size; a list with no nextCursor passes.
rules.passCriteria: No nextCursor on resources/list, or a string nextCursor that yields another valid page when passed back as cursor.
rules.failCriteria: A non-string nextCursor, or a follow-up page that errors or is malformed.

rules.name: prompts/list returns valid response
rules.description: Calls prompts/list and validates the result has a prompts array of objects. Servers that declare the prompts capability must serve prompts/list; required at runtime when the capability is declared.
rules.passCriteria: prompts/list returns a result with a prompts array whose entries are objects (empty allowed).
rules.failCriteria: A JSON-RPC error, or a result without a prompts array of objects.

rules.name: prompts/list carries caching hints
rules.description: Checks ttlMs (an integer >= 0) and cacheScope ('public' or 'private') on the prompts/list result. Both hints are a MUST on every complete prompts/list result. Required at runtime when the prompts capability is declared.
rules.passCriteria: The prompts/list result carries ttlMs as an integer >= 0 and cacheScope equal to public or private.
rules.failCriteria: Either hint missing or invalid.

rules.name: prompts/get returns valid messages
rules.description: Gets the first listed prompt with empty arguments and validates the result: resultType 'complete' with a messages array whose items have a role of user or assistant and a content block, or resultType 'input_required' with a valid InputRequiredResult. A -32602 error for a prompt whose required arguments are missing also passes. Required at runtime when the prompts capability is declared.
rules.passCriteria: Getting the first listed prompt returns resultType 'complete' with a messages array whose items have role user or assistant and a content block, resultType 'input_required' with a valid InputRequiredResult, or a -32602 error for missing required arguments.
rules.failCriteria: A result without resultType, a missing or malformed messages array, or an error other than -32602.

rules.name: prompts/list supports pagination
rules.description: Reads prompts/list and, when nextCursor is present, verifies it is a string and that passing it back as cursor returns another valid page. Cursors are opaque and page size is the server's choice; a list with no nextCursor passes.
rules.passCriteria: No nextCursor on prompts/list, or a string nextCursor that yields another valid page when passed back as cursor.
rules.failCriteria: A non-string nextCursor, or a follow-up page that errors or is malformed.

rules.name: Unknown method returns JSON-RPC error
rules.description: Sends a method name that does not exist (compliance/nonexistent) with a full modern _meta and expects a JSON-RPC error response echoing the request id. On HTTP the server MUST respond 404 Not Found together with the JSON-RPC error body, so a 404 + error passes, an error carried on a 200 passes with a warning on the status, and a result fails.
rules.passCriteria: A JSON-RPC error echoing the request id; on HTTP a 404 status passes cleanly and an error carried on 200 passes with a warning.
rules.failCriteria: A result, no response, or an error that does not echo the request id.

rules.name: Unknown method uses -32601
rules.description: Checks that the error returned for the unknown method carries exactly code -32601 (Method not found). MCP uses the standard JSON-RPC 2.0 codes for protocol failures and a server MUST use defined codes only with their specified meanings; -32600, -32000 or an application code here fail.
rules.passCriteria: The unknown-method error carries exactly code -32601.
rules.failCriteria: Any other code (-32600, -32000, or an application code).

rules.name: Handles malformed JSON-RPC
rules.description: POSTs a JSON object that is not a valid JSON-RPC request (no method, no id) with otherwise correct headers and expects a JSON-RPC error or a 4xx status. Requests MUST carry jsonrpc, method and a string or integer id; a 5xx or a result fails.
rules.passCriteria: A JSON object with no method and no id draws a JSON-RPC error or an HTTP 4xx status.
rules.failCriteria: A result, a 5xx status, or no response.

rules.name: Handles invalid JSON body
rules.description: POSTs a body that is not JSON ('{not json') with the standard headers and expects a parse error (-32700) or a 4xx status. A 5xx, a hang, or an HTML error page fails.
rules.passCriteria: The body '{not json' draws a -32700 error or an HTTP 4xx status.
rules.failCriteria: A 5xx status, a hang, or an HTML error page.

rules.name: Returns -32700 for invalid JSON
rules.description: Checks that the response to the invalid-JSON body carries exactly code -32700 (Parse error), the JSON-RPC 2.0 code MCP reuses for unparsable input. A bare 400 with no JSON-RPC body passes with a warning; a different error code fails.
rules.passCriteria: The invalid-JSON response carries exactly code -32700; a bare 400 with no JSON-RPC body passes with a warning.
rules.failCriteria: A JSON-RPC error with a code other than -32700.

rules.name: Returns -32600 for invalid request
rules.description: Checks that the malformed-envelope response carries exactly code -32600 (Invalid Request). A bare 400 without a JSON-RPC body passes with a warning; -32601 or -32602 for a message that has no method at all fails.
rules.passCriteria: The malformed-envelope response carries exactly code -32600; a bare 400 with no JSON-RPC body passes with a warning.
rules.failCriteria: A JSON-RPC error with a code other than -32600 (for example -32601 or -32602).

rules.name: tools/call without name returns error
rules.description: Calls tools/call with params carrying only _meta (no name) and expects a JSON-RPC error, -32602 Invalid params expected. A request that fails the CallToolRequest schema is a protocol error and must not produce a result. Skipped when the server declares no tools.
rules.passCriteria: tools/call with params carrying only _meta (no name) draws a JSON-RPC error (-32602 expected). Skipped when the server declares no tools.
rules.failCriteria: A result is returned.

rules.name: Unknown tool name returns error
rules.description: Calls tools/call with a tool name the server did not list and expects a JSON-RPC error (-32602 expected) or a result with isError: true. An unknown tool is a protocol error the model cannot fix; a successful result with empty content fails. Skipped when the server declares no tools.
rules.passCriteria: tools/call with a name the server did not list draws a JSON-RPC error (-32602 expected) or a result with isError: true. Skipped when the server declares no tools.
rules.failCriteria: A successful result without isError: true.

rules.name: Rejects methods for undeclared capabilities
rules.description: Calls the list method (tools/list, resources/list, prompts/list) for every capability the discover result did NOT declare and expects a JSON-RPC error, -32601 expected. Capabilities are the contract for which methods exist; serving an undeclared one means clients cannot trust the discover result. Skipped when every capability is declared.
rules.passCriteria: Every list method for a capability the discover result did not declare draws a JSON-RPC error (-32601 expected). Skipped when every capability is declared.
rules.failCriteria: A list method for an undeclared capability returns a result.

rules.name: Handles invalid pagination cursor
rules.description: Sends a garbage cursor to the first list method the server supports and expects either a JSON-RPC error (-32602 expected, which is what the pagination page says an invalid cursor SHOULD produce) or a valid first page. A 5xx, a crash, or a malformed result fails.
rules.passCriteria: A garbage cursor on the first supported list method draws a JSON-RPC error (-32602 expected) or a valid first page.
rules.failCriteria: A 5xx status, a crash, or a malformed result.

rules.name: Error responses echo the request id
rules.description: Post-hoc scan of every JSON-RPC error the server sent during the run: each one answering a request whose id was readable MUST carry that same id. Errors for unparsable bodies (parse errors, malformed envelopes) are exempt because the id could not be read; a null or missing id on the reply to a well-formed request fails.
rules.passCriteria: Every recorded error that answers a request with a readable id carries that same id; parse and malformed-envelope errors are exempt.
rules.failCriteria: An error with a null or missing id in reply to a well-formed request.

rules.name: No retired error codes
rules.description: Post-hoc scan of every error the server sent for the codes retired in 2026-07-28: -32002 (resource not found, replaced by -32602) and -32042 (URL elicitation required, replaced by MRTR). Implementations of this revision MUST NOT emit either; any occurrence fails.
rules.passCriteria: No recorded error carries code -32002 or -32042.
rules.failCriteria: Any occurrence of either code.

rules.name: All tools have name and inputSchema
rules.description: Validates every listed tool has a name (1-128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_.-], the SHOULD-level naming rule) and an inputSchema that is a JSON Schema object with type 'object'. inputSchema MUST be a valid JSON Schema object, not null.
rules.passCriteria: Every listed tool has a name matching [A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,128} and an inputSchema object with type 'object'.
rules.failCriteria: Any tool with a missing or malformed name, or an inputSchema that is absent, null, or not type 'object'.

rules.name: Tool annotations are valid
rules.description: If a tool carries annotations, validates that readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint and openWorldHint are booleans when present and that title, when present, is a string. Clients MUST treat annotations as untrusted hints, so a wrong type is a definition bug rather than a security control.
rules.passCriteria: On every tool that carries annotations, readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint and openWorldHint are booleans when present and title is a string when present.
rules.failCriteria: Any annotation hint with a non-boolean value, or a non-string annotations.title.

rules.name: Tools include title field
rules.description: Checks whether listed tools carry the optional title field, the human-readable display name clients prefer over name. Passes when every tool has a string title; tools without one are listed in the details.
rules.passCriteria: Every listed tool has a string title.
rules.failCriteria: Any tool without a string title (the offenders are named in the details).

rules.name: Tools with outputSchema are valid
rules.description: For tools that declare outputSchema, validates it is a JSON Schema object (a non-null object; type, $ref or a composition keyword may describe any JSON value). Unlike 2025-11-25 the root is no longer restricted to type 'object': array, string and other roots are valid because structuredContent may be any JSON value.
rules.passCriteria: Every declared outputSchema is a non-null JSON Schema object; any root type is accepted.
rules.failCriteria: An outputSchema that is null, not an object, or otherwise not a JSON Schema object.

rules.name: Prompts have name field
rules.description: Validates every listed prompt has a string name and that each entry in an arguments array has a name. Prompt arguments are matched by name in prompts/get and completion/complete, so a nameless argument is unreachable.
rules.passCriteria: Every listed prompt has a string name and every entry in its arguments array has a name.
rules.failCriteria: A prompt without a string name, or an argument without a name.

rules.name: Resources have uri and name
rules.description: Validates every listed resource has a parseable URI and a string name. Custom URI schemes MUST conform to RFC 3986; an unparseable uri cannot be passed back to resources/read.
rules.passCriteria: Every listed resource has a parseable absolute URI and a string name.
rules.failCriteria: An unparseable uri, or a missing or non-string name.

rules.name: Every result carries resultType
rules.description: Post-hoc scan of every JSON-RPC result the server sent during the run: each result MUST include a string resultType ('complete', 'input_required', or a value defined by an advertised extension). A result with no resultType is what a 2025-11-25 server returns and fails here.
rules.passCriteria: Every recorded JSON-RPC result carries a string resultType.
rules.failCriteria: Any result without a string resultType.

rules.name: input_required only on MRTR methods
rules.description: Post-hoc scan of every result with resultType 'input_required', traced back to the request that produced it. Servers MAY return an InputRequiredResult only for tools/call, prompts/get and resources/read and MUST NOT on any other request; an input_required result on server/discover, a list method, completion/complete or subscriptions/listen fails.
rules.passCriteria: Every recorded input_required result answers tools/call, prompts/get, or resources/read.
rules.failCriteria: An input_required result on server/discover, a list method, completion/complete, subscriptions/listen, or any other method.

rules.name: InputRequiredResult is well-formed
rules.description: Post-hoc, opportunistic check of every input_required result observed: it MUST include at least one of inputRequests or requestState; each inputRequests value must be an object whose method is elicitation/create, sampling/createMessage or roots/list with a params object; requestState, when present, must be a string. Passes vacuously when no input_required result was seen.
rules.passCriteria: Every observed input_required result has inputRequests and/or requestState; each inputRequests value is an object whose method is elicitation/create, sampling/createMessage or roots/list with a params object; requestState is a string when present. Passes vacuously when none was observed.
rules.failCriteria: An input_required result missing both fields, a malformed inputRequests entry, or a non-string requestState.

rules.name: Messages validate against the 2026-07-28 schema
rules.description: Post-hoc validation of every recorded server message against the vendored 2026-07-28 JSON schema, dispatching by method for notifications, by resultType plus the originating request's method for results, and by error code for errors. The TypeScript schema is the source of truth for every message; the details list the first offending messages with their validation errors.
rules.passCriteria: Every recorded server message validates against the vendored 2026-07-28 JSON schema for its message type.
rules.failCriteria: Any message that fails schema validation (the first offenders and their errors are listed in the details).

rules.name: Rejects unauthenticated requests
rules.description: Sends a fully conformant server/discover with the Authorization header removed and expects HTTP 401 (403 also passes). Servers acting as OAuth 2.1 resource servers MUST answer missing or invalid tokens with 401. Without --auth the test fails, reporting that the server accepted an unauthenticated request.
rules.passCriteria: A conformant server/discover with the Authorization header removed draws HTTP 401 (403 also passes). Requires --auth.
rules.failCriteria: Any other status, or the run has no --auth (the server accepted an unauthenticated request).

rules.name: 401 responses include WWW-Authenticate
rules.description: When the unauthenticated server/discover yields 401, checks for a WWW-Authenticate header. Servers MUST implement one of two discovery mechanisms, and the header form (Bearer resource_metadata="...") is the one clients try first; a 401 with no challenge leaves the client unable to locate the authorization server. Skipped when no 401 was observed.
rules.passCriteria: The 401 observed by security-auth-required carries a WWW-Authenticate header. Skipped when no 401 was observed.
rules.failCriteria: A 401 with no WWW-Authenticate header.

rules.name: Rejects malformed auth credentials
rules.description: Sends a conformant server/discover with Authorization: Bearer <garbage> and expects HTTP 401 (403 also passes). Servers MUST validate access tokens, including their audience, and invalid or expired tokens MUST receive 401; a server that only checks that the header is present fails.
rules.passCriteria: Authorization: Bearer <garbage> on a conformant server/discover draws HTTP 401 (403 also passes).
rules.failCriteria: Any other status (the token was not validated).

rules.name: Enforces HTTPS/TLS
rules.description: If the server URL is https, sends the same modern server/discover over plain http to the same host and expects a refusal or a redirect to https. Communication security follows OAuth 2.1: a bearer token on a plaintext connection is exposed to every intermediary. An http target fails outright (production servers should not be reachable in the clear).
rules.passCriteria: For an https target, the same server/discover over plain http to the same host is refused or redirected to https.
rules.failCriteria: A result over plaintext, or an http target (fails outright).

rules.name: Protected Resource Metadata endpoint exists
rules.description: Fetches /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource (root first, then the endpoint-path variant) and validates a JSON document with resource and a non-empty authorization_servers array. MCP servers MUST implement RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata and the document MUST name at least one authorization server. A legacy /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server hit passes with a warning.
rules.passCriteria: /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource (root, then the endpoint-path variant) returns JSON with resource and a non-empty authorization_servers array; a legacy /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server hit passes with a warning.
rules.failCriteria: Neither document is served, or the document lacks resource or a non-empty authorization_servers.

rules.name: Rejects auth tokens in query string
rules.description: Sends a conformant server/discover with the Authorization header removed and the configured token placed in the URL query string (?access_token=...) and expects HTTP 401. Access tokens MUST NOT be included in the URI query string; a server that accepts them there teaches clients to leak tokens into logs and Referer headers. Requires --auth.
rules.passCriteria: A server/discover with the token moved from the Authorization header to the ?access_token= query parameter draws HTTP 401. Requires --auth.
rules.failCriteria: Any status other than 401 (the query-string token was honoured).

rules.name: CORS headers are restrictive
rules.description: Sends a conformant server/discover with an Origin header from a plausible web app and inspects Access-Control-Allow-Origin on the response. A wildcard (*) on an endpoint that accepts bearer credentials lets any page drive the server from a browser; specific origins, or no CORS headers at all, pass.
rules.passCriteria: Access-Control-Allow-Origin on the server/discover response is absent or names a specific origin.
rules.failCriteria: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * is returned.

rules.name: Validates Origin header
